Look into the amazing Otto Graham and Jim Brown. Not only were we the cream of the crop during those days, Otto is one of the most successful QBs to ever play and Jim Brown is arguably the greatest RB to ever play. Amazing history in those two decades.

You should be familiar with most of the following topics:

  • The Fumble
  • The Drive
  • Red Right 88
  • The Cardiac Kids
  • Jim Brown
  • Bernie Kosar
  • Brian Sipe
  • Paul Brown
  • 1995 and the Move
  • 1999 and the Return
  • Bottlegate
  • Know at least a few of the starting QBs since the return (Couch, Anderson, Quinn and Weeden is a good starting point)

If you familiarize yourself with some of that and still want to be a fan, you're a strong enough person to support yourself through years of disappointment. Welcome aboard.
